photos.desc: Harlequin rasboras in a fish tank

Eight Harlequin Rasboras ( Trigonostigma heteromorpha ) in a 120 litre tank. To the right one can also see a Mystery snail ( Pomacea bridgesii ) on the glass pane. The aquatic plants in the background
Trigonostigma heteromorpha HARLEQUIN RASBORA. Frankfurt Zoological Garden.
